dedupe_keys.name: czepos national network of permanent gnss stations czech republic

description: CZEPOS is the Czech national network of permanent stations for precise positioning, managed and operated by the Land Survey Office as part of the geodetic foundations of the Czech Republic. It provides users of global navigation satellite systems with correction data for precise positioning across the country, in RTK and DGPS categories from single stations, network VRS services, and RINEX data products. News on the page read records a new station at Opava in service from 22 March 2026, the end of RTK and DGPS services from Ostrava on 31 March 2026 while it stays in the network solution and RINEX products, a new station at Olomouc in 2024, and a February 2025 software update that added new GNSS frequencies such as BeiDou 3 and Galileo E6 and was prompted by the expected solar maximum of 2025, with a new application for checking the accuracy of the network solution. Access is through the services and products described on the site; no licence or price is stated on the page read. Caveats: the site is in Czech, and service details are on the information pages. Coverage is the Czech Republic. It supports positioning infrastructure studies and space weather effects on GNSS, which the operator itself links to the solar cycle; related records are SAPOS of Germany, SWEPOS of Sweden and ERGNSS of Spain.
